title: Esquiva 3D — player jump (hop over enemies + recover onto arena from collapsing edge)
description: Add a jump button to the Esquiva 3D demo. While airborne the player is immune to being caught by chaser obstacles (jump OVER enemies) and immune to falling into the void; XZ air-control stays enabled so the player can steer back over solid ground. On landing the grounded cell is evaluated: solid -> survive (recover 'back inside' from a collapsing edge), void -> fall/lose; an enemy on the landing cell still catches. No double-jump (cannot jump while already airborne) to prevent infinite hover. Rules change lives in Barcade.Core.Dodge.DodgeSim (tests-first, fast suite). View layer (DodgeGameBootstrap) adds the input button (Space + gamepad South) and a parabolic hop arc driven by sim jump progress; primitive-cube fallback unaffected; Core stays engine-free.
acceptance_criteria: DodgeSim exposes RequestJump(), IsAirborne (bool), and JumpProgress01 (0 at takeoff, 1 at land); jumpDuration is a constructor param with a sensible default and appended so existing call sites compile unchanged
While airborne, CheckPlayerFell and CheckPlayerCaught are suppressed; the player keeps moving in XZ from input (air control)
On the landing frame, ground checks run: landing on a non-solid cell -> Lost(Fell); landing on/under an enemy within contactRadius -> Lost(Caught); landing on a clear solid cell -> still Playing
RequestJump while already airborne is ignored (no double-jump, no timer refresh/extension)

Tests-first: failing fast-suite tests encode each rule above (airborne fall-immunity, land-back-on-solid survival, hop-over-enemy immunity, no-double-jump, catch-on-landing) before implementation; all green after
Existing fast suite stays green (no regression to the prior 261 tests; total grows by the new jump tests)

DodgeGameBootstrap reads a jump input (Space + <Gamepad>/buttonSouth -> RequestJump) and renders a parabolic hop arc (serialized jumpApex) using IsAirborne/JumpProgress01, independent of the death-fall animation; primitive-cube fallback path still works headless

comments.body: Closed on human UAT PASS (jump plays well) + fresh-context reviewer APPROVE-WITH-NITS (rev-dodge, zero HIGH). Tests-first: 6 new DodgeSim jump tests authored before implementation; fast suite 267/267 (was 261). Airborne immune to Fell+Caught with XZ air-control; landing-frame ground checks (solid=survive, void=Fell, enemy=Caught); no double-jump. View: Space/<Gamepad>/buttonSouth -> RequestJump + parabolic hop arc (jumpApex). Non-gating nits (weak recover test, no Lost/Won jump test, jumpDuration not Inspector-serialized) folded into TASK-020.
